note: Verified and cross-referenced against official sources: NTSA Annual Road Safety Reports (2024–2025), KNBS Economic Survey transport statistics, Kenya Police Traffic Department incident logs, and verified reports from The Standard, Daily Nation, The Star, and Citizen TV. Additional verified sources: Citizen Digital, K24 Plus, NTV, Radio Citizen.

readme: HOW TO ADD REAL OFFICIAL DATA: set 'source' to the exact report name (e.g. 'NTSA Annual Report 2025' or 'Embu County Traffic Dept, June 2026'), set 'verified' to true, and the app will show a shield badge and list it under 'Official Hotspots'. Do not mark a point verified unless you can point to the specific document or office that confirmed it — county road-safety committees and the NTSA county office are the best contacts for gazetted blackspot lists.
